name: Default
shortDescription: Rust download manager server with a web UI for HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, magnet links and HLS/DASH streams, storing its data in SQLite.

alerts.message: Sign in to the web UI with the access key in FLUXDOWN_TOKEN from the environment. It only seeds the key on first start: once you change it under Settings, Security & Access, the new key is the one that counts.
